summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing summarized minutes of its Fiscal Council meeting held on May 5, 2026. The council reviewed the company's financial statements for Q1 2026 and issued an unqualified opinion reflecting fairly the capital structure, financial position, and activities. No special-situation transaction—such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, management change, or other event-driven classification—is present. This is a routine current report on earnings review by the fiscal council.
